table.name: absence
table.remarks: stores employee absences, operational interruptions, and approval lifecycle

column.name: sta_abs
column.remarks: workflow state using centralized absence_status enum

column.name: res_abs
column.remarks: employee responsible for absence validation or resolution

table.name: anamnesis
table.remarks: client-reported history snippets tied to appointments

table.name: animal
table.remarks: clinical and administrative record for each animal patient

table.name: appointment
table.remarks: scheduling and consultation session for a client animal with assigned veterinarian and declared clinical specialty

column.name: id_spe
column.remarks: clinical specialty requested for this consultation; FK to module 1 specialty catalog; must match an expert(id_emp,id_spe) assignment for the veterinarian

column.name: dia_app
column.remarks: diagnosis captured when closing the visit

table.name: appointment_notification
table.remarks: client notifications such as reminders generated by jobs or procedures

table.name: assistant
table.remarks: defines assistant employees and their operational functions

table.name: breed
table.remarks: breed catalog scoped to a parent species

table.name: client
table.remarks: stores client authentication and operational lifecycle information

column.name: id_usr
column.remarks: reference to associated user account; unique per row (one client per user_account)

checkConstraint.constraint: (((reg_dat_cli <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ((ina_dat_cli IS NULL) OR ((ina_dat_cli >= reg_dat_cli) AND (ina_dat_cli <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))))
checkConstraint.name: ck_client_dates

table.name: clock_in
table.remarks: stores employee attendance intervals and operational presence records

checkConstraint.constraint: (((sta_dat_clk <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ((end_dat_clk IS NULL) OR ((end_dat_clk > sta_dat_clk) AND (end_dat_clk <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))))
checkConstraint.name: ck_clock_time

table.name: concession
table.remarks: transfer of an animal to an external entity with clinical context

table.name: delivery
table.remarks: rescue or intake workflow metadata for an animal

table.name: delivery_employee
table.remarks: associates employees with a delivery operation

table.name: employee
table.remarks: stores operational employee authentication and lifecycle information

checkConstraint.constraint: (((reg_dat_emp <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ((dea_dat_emp IS NULL) OR ((dea_dat_emp >= reg_dat_emp) AND (dea_dat_emp <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))))
checkConstraint.name: ck_employee_dates

checkConstraint.constraint: ((((dea_dat_emp IS NULL) AND (aut_ina_emp IS NULL)) OR ((dea_dat_emp IS NOT NULL) AND (aut_ina_emp IS NOT NULL))))
checkConstraint.name: ck_employee_inactivation

table.name: expert
table.remarks: associates veterinarians with one or more specialties

table.name: external_entity
table.remarks: partners such as shelters or suppliers involved in intake or transfers

table.name: family
table.remarks: product family or category grouping for catalog organization

table.name: have
table.remarks: associates profiles with granular operational permissions

table.name: invoice
table.remarks: billing header that may reference an appointment

column.name: sta_inv
column.remarks: invoice workflow state using centralized invoice_status enum

column.name: id_app
column.remarks: consultation back-reference mirrored from appointment.id_inv (unique when set; retail invoices stay null)

table.name: invoice_line
table.remarks: sales line items contributing to invoice totals

column.name: iva_inv_lin
column.remarks: vat rate applied to the line

table.name: login_record
table.remarks: stores authentication attempts, session lifecycle, and login audit history

column.name: ip_add_log
column.remarks: ip address used during authentication attempt

column.name: ema_log
column.remarks: email snapshot used during authentication attempt

column.name: id_usr
column.remarks: reference to associated user account when applicable

checkConstraint.constraint: (((ema_log IS NULL) OR (((ema_log)::text = lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM ema_log))) AND ((ema_log)::text ~ '.+@.+\..+'::text))))
checkConstraint.name: ck_ema_log_format

checkConstraint.constraint: (((sig_tim_log <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND ((sou_tim_log IS NULL) OR ((sou_tim_log > sig_tim_log) AND (sou_tim_log <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)))))
checkConstraint.name: ck_login_time

checkConstraint.constraint: (((suc_log = false) OR ((id_usr IS NOT NULL) AND (ema_log IS NOT NULL) AND (ip_add_log IS NOT NULL) AND (sig_tim_log IS NOT NULL) AND (ip_add_log IS NOT NULL))))
checkConstraint.name: login_record_check

table.name: occupies
table.remarks: associates employees with operational access profiles

table.name: overall_assessment
table.remarks: structured vitals captured during an appointment

column.name: id_app
column.remarks: primary key and foreign key to appointment

column.name: hrt_rat_ova
column.remarks: heart rate in beats per minute

column.name: res_rat_ova
column.remarks: respiratory rate in breaths per minute

table.name: ownership
table.remarks: client-to-animal ownership intervals with optional staff attribution

table.name: permission
table.remarks: defines granular permissions used for access control

table.name: prescription
table.remarks: prescription metadata issued during a consultation

table.name: product
table.remarks: catalog item with pricing, tax, and lifecycle metadata

column.name: ina_dat_pro
column.remarks: inactivation timestamp when the sku retires

table.name: profile
table.remarks: defines operational roles and access profiles within the system

column.name: des_pro
column.remarks: description of profile responsibilities and purpose

table.name: purchase
table.remarks: purchase order header with totals and workflow status

column.name: sta_pur
column.remarks: workflow state using centralized purchase_status enum (nullable until confirmed)

column.name: id_inv
column.remarks: linked invoice when billed (nullable; no FK)

column.name: id_cli
column.remarks: client for retail purchases (nullable; no FK)

table.name: purchase_line
table.remarks: line-level detail for incoming stock tied to a purchase

column.name: id_sto
column.remarks: stock row created on receive (nullable; no FK; set by sp_receive_purchase)

table.name: rel_app_product
table.remarks: products consumed or billed directly through an appointment

column.name: qty_pre_pro
column.remarks: quantity associated with the appointment usage

table.name: rel_pre_prod
table.remarks: line items that materialize a prescription into catalog skus

table.name: return
table.remarks: commercial return header: one client, one employee, one product; optional invoice line trace

column.name: id_pro
column.remarks: returned product (source of truth for restock)

column.name: id_inv_lin
column.remarks: optional originating invoice line (nullable; no FK; validated in tfn_return_restock)

table.name: schedule
table.remarks: defines recurring weekly operational schedules for employees

column.name: day_wee_sch
column.remarks: day of the week associated with the schedule entry

checkConstraint.constraint: (((sta_tim_sch < fin_hou_sch) AND (sta_tim_sch >= '00:00:00'::time without time zone) AND (fin_hou_sch <= '23:59:59'::time without time zone)))
checkConstraint.name: ck_schedule_time

table.name: setup
table.remarks: stores user interface preferences and operational configuration settings

checkConstraint.constraint: ((((the_set)::text = lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM the_set))) AND ((the_set)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['light'::character varying, 'dark'::character varying])::text[]))))
checkConstraint.name: ck_the_set_format

table.name: specialty
table.remarks: defines veterinary and operational specialties

column.name: des_spe
column.remarks: description of specialty scope and responsibilities (required)

checkConstraint.constraint: (((des_spe = TRIM(BOTH FROM des_spe)) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM des_spe)) >= 5)))
checkConstraint.name: ck_des_spe_format

checkConstraint.constraint: ((((nam_spe)::text = lower(TRIM(BOTH FROM nam_spe))) AND (length(TRIM(BOTH FROM nam_spe)) >= 5)))
checkConstraint.name: ck_nam_spe_format

table.name: species
table.remarks: catalog of animal species supported by the clinic

table.name: stock
table.remarks: quantity ledger per product with batch and expiry metadata

table.name: user_account
table.remarks: stores general personal, contact, and identification data for all system users

column.name: id_usr
column.remarks: unique identifier of the user account

column.name: nam_usr
column.remarks: full legal name of the user

column.name: add_usr
column.remarks: residential or registered address of the user

column.name: pho_usr
column.remarks: personal phone number stored in international format

column.name: ema_usr
column.remarks: personal normalized email address excluding corporate domains

table.name: veterinarian
table.remarks: defines veterinarian employees and professional specialization

table.name: vw_active_employee_directory
table.remarks: active employees joined to user_account for directory and scheduling consumers
table.viewSql: SELECT e.id_emp, e.id_usr, u.nam_usr, e.ema_emp, e.pho_emp, e.pho_emg, e.reg_dat_emp FROM (employee e JOIN user_account u ON ((u.id_usr = e.id_usr))) WHERE (e.dea_dat_emp IS NULL);

table.name: vw_active_login_sessions
table.viewSql: SELECT lr.id_log, lr.id_usr, lr.ema_log, lr.sig_tim_log, lr.sou_tim_log, lr.suc_log, lr.ip_add_log FROM login_record lr WHERE ((lr.sou_tim_log IS NULL) AND (lr.suc_log = true));

table.name: vw_active_ownership_detail
table.remarks: open ownership intervals with client, animal, and taxonomy attributes
table.viewSql: SELECT o.id_own, o.id_ani, o.id_cli, u.nam_usr AS client_name, u.ema_usr AS client_email, a.reg_id_ani, a.nam_ani, a.sta_ani, s.nam_spc, b.nam_bre, o.sta_dat_own, o.mot_own, o.id_emp FROM (((((ownership o JOIN client c ON ((c.id_cli = o.id_cli))) JOIN user_account u ON ((u.id_usr = c.id_usr))) JOIN animal a ON ((a.id_ani = o.id_ani))) JOIN species s ON ((s.id_spc = a.id_spc))) LEFT JOIN breed b ON ((b.id_bre = a.id_bre))) WHERE (o.end_dat_own IS NULL);

table.name: vw_animal_catalog_detail
table.remarks: full animal registry joined to species, breed, and active ownership owner identity
table.viewSql: SELECT a.id_ani, a.reg_id_ani, a.nam_ani, a.dat_bir_ani, a.gen_ani, a.ori_ani, a.sta_ani, a.reg_dat_ani, a.ina_dat_ani, s.id_spc, s.nam_spc, b.id_bre, b.nam_bre, o.id_cli, u.nam_usr AS owner_name, u.ema_usr AS owner_email FROM (((((animal a JOIN species s ON ((s.id_spc = a.id_spc))) LEFT JOIN breed b ON ((b.id_bre = a.id_bre))) LEFT JOIN ownership o ON (((o.id_ani = a.id_ani) AND (o.end_dat_own IS NULL)))) LEFT JOIN client c ON ((c.id_cli = o.id_cli))) LEFT JOIN user_account u ON ((u.id_usr = c.id_usr)));

table.name: vw_appointment_detail
table.remarks: appointments enriched with client, clinician, animal, and specialty context
table.viewSql: SELECT a.id_app, a.sch_dat_app, a.sta_dat_app, a.end_dat_app, a.status_app, a.id_cli, u_cli.nam_usr AS client_name, u_cli.ema_usr AS client_email, a.id_emp, u_emp.nam_usr AS veterinarian_name, e.ema_emp AS veterinarian_email, a.id_ani, an.reg_id_ani, an.nam_ani AS animal_name, sp.nam_spc, br.nam_bre, a.id_spe, s.nam_spe AS appointment_specialty, a.id_inv, a.dia_app, a.com_app FROM ((((((((appointment a JOIN client c ON ((c.id_cli = a.id_cli))) JOIN user_account u_cli ON ((u_cli.id_usr = c.id_usr))) JOIN employee e ON ((e.id_emp = a.id_emp))) JOIN user_account u_emp ON ((u_emp.id_usr = e.id_usr))) JOIN animal an ON ((an.id_ani = a.id_ani))) JOIN specialty s ON ((s.id_spe = a.id_spe))) JOIN species sp ON ((sp.id_spc = an.id_spc))) LEFT JOIN breed br ON ((br.id_bre = an.id_bre)));

table.name: vw_appointments_today
table.remarks: scheduled and in-progress appointments for the current calendar day
table.viewSql: SELECT d.id_app, d.sch_dat_app, d.sta_dat_app, d.end_dat_app, d.status_app, d.client_name, d.veterinarian_name, d.animal_name, d.appointment_specialty FROM vw_appointment_detail d WHERE (((d.sch_dat_app)::date = CURRENT_DATE) AND (d.status_app = ANY (ARRAY['scheduled'::appointment_status, 'in_progress'::appointment_status])));

table.name: vw_internal_animals_available
table.remarks: non-inactivated animals in internal status available for adoption workflows
table.viewSql: SELECT a.id_ani, a.reg_id_ani, a.nam_ani, a.sta_ani, s.nam_spc, b.nam_bre, a.reg_dat_ani FROM ((animal a JOIN species s ON ((s.id_spc = a.id_spc))) LEFT JOIN breed b ON ((b.id_bre = a.id_bre))) WHERE (((a.sta_ani)::text = 'Interno'::text) AND (a.ina_dat_ani IS NULL));

table.name: vw_open_clock_in_sessions
table.remarks: open clock-in rows without end timestamp, enriched with employee identity
table.viewSql: SELECT c.id_clk, c.id_emp, u.nam_usr, e.ema_emp, c.sta_dat_clk, c.end_dat_clk FROM ((clock_in c JOIN employee e ON ((e.id_emp = c.id_emp))) JOIN user_account u ON ((u.id_usr = e.id_usr))) WHERE (c.end_dat_clk IS NULL);

table.name: vw_operational_absences
table.remarks: pending, approved, and detected absences with employee and user context
table.viewSql: SELECT a.id_abs, a.id_emp, u.nam_usr, e.ema_emp, a.sta_dat_tim_abs, a.end_dat_tim_abs, a.mot_abs, a.sta_abs, a.res_abs, a.cre_tim_abs FROM ((absence a JOIN employee e ON ((e.id_emp = a.id_emp))) JOIN user_account u ON ((u.id_usr = e.id_usr))) WHERE (a.sta_abs = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::absence_status, 'approved'::absence_status, 'detected'::absence_status]));

table.name: vw_product_stock_levels
table.remarks: active catalog products with family metadata and consolidated available quantity
table.viewSql: SELECT p.id_pro, p.ref_pro, p.bar_pro, p.nam_pro, f.id_fam, f.nam_fam, p.pri_pro, p.iva_pro, p.min_sto, fn_get_available_stock(p.id_pro) AS qty_available, p.reg_dat_pro, p.ina_dat_pro FROM (product p JOIN family f ON ((f.id_fam = p.id_fam))) WHERE (p.ina_dat_pro IS NULL);

table.name: vw_products_to_reorder
table.remarks: active products at or below minimum stock; consumed by sp_check_restock_needs
table.viewSql: SELECT p.id_pro, p.nam_pro, f.nam_fam, fn_get_available_stock(p.id_pro) AS qty_available, p.min_sto, ((p.min_sto * 2) - fn_get_available_stock(p.id_pro)) AS qty_reorder_suggestion FROM (product p JOIN family f ON ((f.id_fam = p.id_fam))) WHERE ((fn_get_available_stock(p.id_pro) <= p.min_sto) AND (p.ina_dat_pro IS NULL));

table.name: vw_scheduled_appointments_tomorrow
table.remarks: scheduled appointments for the next calendar day; supports reminder workflows
table.viewSql: SELECT d.id_app, d.id_cli, d.client_name, d.client_email, d.id_emp, d.veterinarian_name, d.id_ani, d.animal_name, d.sch_dat_app, d.status_app FROM vw_appointment_detail d WHERE ((d.status_app = 'scheduled'::appointment_status) AND ((d.sch_dat_app)::date = (CURRENT_DATE + '1 day'::interval)));
